target: Korean V-League women, full-match two-way winner; one unique game and one complete same-product quote per decision
question: Does officially confirmed starting setter change improve probabilistic prediction beyond same-time market and no-fact baseline?
feature: Binary home and away change from prior completed match starting setter; only when both team lineups and the prior baseline are confirmed and received by decision. Missing is unknown, not unchanged. Player role and identity must be uniquely matched. No manual probability adjustment; estimate a regularized two-coefficient logistic market-offset model using women-only training data.
context: Official roster, setter and attacker composition, prior completed match reception and rest are audited separately; these are not fitted predictors in this single initial candidate. Set transitions require point/set timestamps and are future research, not target-game features.
decision: Actual decision at or before kickoff minus 30 minutes; both official bytes and complete odds received by decision; event timestamps and authenticated receipt evidence retained separately. Published timestamps and local hashes alone do not prove receipt.
split: After protocol commit, register a new event-id/input SHA batch and immutable collection window before examining outcomes. Chronologically allocate first 60% of eligible games to train, next 20% validation, last 20% final test, keeping each calendar day wholly in one split. Labels enter training only after independently evidenced result receipt and before training cutoff; no same-day or future outcomes.
selection: Predetermine L2 penalties [1,10,100]. Choose minimum validation log loss, ties larger penalty. Fit market-only baseline and candidate on identical eligible games. Proceed only with at least 200 train, 70 validation, 100 test eligible games, at least 20 changed-setter games in train and 10 each in validation and test, and both outcomes per split. Otherwise blocked_data; no tuning on test.
stop: Stop for invalid timestamps, ambiguous identity, missing actual source bytes, incomplete odds, duplicate documents without adjudication, unavailable prior-setter baseline, poisoned future labels affecting earlier forecasts, or insufficient split counts. No fitting without new actual evidence; no production promotion.
comparators: Market implied probabilities normalized over the complete same-time two-way quote; no-fact market-offset intercept-only model; candidate. Compare exact frozen operating pick only where its authentic decision revision and same market/time/price/settlement are available; report this paired subset separately, including operational abstentions.
metrics: Report opportunities, exclusions by reason, coverage, n, accuracy, flat one-unit ROI, binary log loss, Brier, daily closing max drawdown and paired differences; no ROI if no eligible settled games. Compare same selections' actual observed odds and same official settlement, include pushes/voids under documented rules. Report uncertainty and no causal or executable-edge claim.
verification: Run Python leakage tests: late receipt rejected; after-cutoff label poison cannot change earlier fit; duplicate document bytes detected via calculated SHA256 without assuming independent authors; independently verify saved actual bytes. Ineligible data are not silently repaired.
